applicability: The API can carry state across chunks and produce a final unsigned checksum.
law: Changing chunk boundaries preserves the attested result after finalization.

input_strategy.transform: Feed all chunks to one state in order.

edge_cases: Insert an empty update between chunks.
Move the split close to either end.

oracle.derivation: The chunks concatenate to the RevEng check string. RFC 1662 updates the same state across chunks and complements it once at the end.

known_wrong_implementations: Feed the finalized CRC back to an API expecting raw state.

evidence.license: Catalogue license unspecified. Cite public algorithm parameters and check value.
Unlimited distribution of the RFC under its stated terms.
